name: Obsidian Span
title: Obsidian Span
summary: The Obsidian Span, an Empyrean ruin once hidden by a ward, bridges the broad river north-east of Holtburg, 560 m east-south-east of the Pet Shop. In the kit it is a 290 m chain of black-and-green Empyrean structures standing in running water (z 28) from a rock island in mid-river (z 52) to the east bank: 10-storey piers (to z 61), 6-8-storey halls (to z 68.6), a central deck (z 57-62.6) and two diamond-patterned towers (z 78). The river is ~250 m wide; trees line the banks. Landblocks 0xB4A9-AB (x > 34560) are missing from the kit: all cameras stay west of x 34550 (the gazetteer teleport is on the east bank in 0xB4AA, which is fine for the hidden player).

shots.notes: Establishing view of the Obsidian Span, an Empyrean ruin that bridges the wide river west of the Pet Shop: a 290 m chain of piers, halls and towers (tops 45-78 m) standing in running water.
